panel.status_ready: Ready · type, or tap the mic
panel.header_delete_confirm: Click again to delete (daily notes included)
panel.service_stopped: The service stopped. Close and reopen the panel, or try again.
panel.access_missing: {0}: not set up yet. Click to open its settings.
panel.access_hint: What she has access to. The panel chip turns it on or off; here you set it up. Not set up = dashed; closed by the mode or the role = struck through, and the tooltip says which.
panel.portail_hint: An internal site behind Authelia, plugged in by a private extension (~/.config/omarchy-companion/extensions/portail.py). She opens a session like a browser: give its address, a JSON vault and the section holding “user” and “password”.
panel.portail_writes: Reads from Read mode. Four verbs write, each confirmed by a card: note, ticket, confirm an appointment, field note. Closing, invoicing, validating a quote, deleting: those verbs do not exist.
panel.robot_hint: Her body: the robot shows what she is doing — it listens, thinks, nods while she speaks. Enter the address of the robot service: http://127.0.0.1:8000 if it is plugged into this laptop, the other machine's address if it is there.
panel.robot_use_audio: Speak and listen through the robot
panel.robot_audio_hint: The robot is plugged in here: sets its output and microphone in Voice. Both together — its microphone only cancels the echo of its own speaker.
panel.robot_note: The reflection only shows, like the avatar: it does not go through the brain and acts on nothing else. A card approved, it nods; refused, it shakes its head.
panel.erp_hint: Where to take the address and API key from, without copying them here: a JSON vault and the path of the section holding “url” and “api_key”.
panel.erp_fiscal_month: Fiscal year start month (1 = January, 10 = October)
panel.erp_readonly: Read-only: no verb writes, validates, sends or deletes — they do not exist in the reader.
panel.role_self_desc: Herself. Every mode, every access, shared notebook.
panel.keyring_hint: The secret is stored in the system keyring (gnome-keyring): never in the settings, never shown, never passed to the brain.
panel.keyring_state_missing: No secret stored for this access
panel.keyring_ha: Store the token in the system keyring
panel.backup_export_hint: Preferences and home watch; personality and roles when selected. Credential files and memory are not copied.
panel.backup_pointers: Include vault paths, accounts and addresses
panel.backup_pointers_hint: They are not secrets, but they tell where your secrets are. Off by default, for export and restore alike.
panel.backup_restore_hint: Pick a backup or give a file: a preview shows what would change, nothing is written before “Restore”. The current state is backed up first.
panel.backup_persona_reset: Alison’s personality back to the original.
panel.backup_never: Never restored: the mode, switched-on access, trusted sites, voice approval, the active role, the engine and its address.
panel.backup_content_hint: Free-form text (personality, roles, preferences and rules) may contain confidential information you entered. No filter guarantees its absence. Exclude unwanted content and review the JSON before sharing.
panel.backup_restored: Restored ({0} error(s)). The previous state is in the backups folder.
panel.persona_custom_hint: Custom personality. The original keeps being updated with the plugin.
panel.persona_text_hint: A few sentences: tone, way of answering, what matters to you. A description, never a permission: the safety frame always comes last. Empty = the shipped Alison.
panel.omarchy_knowledge_hint: Reads the official guide shipped with Omarchy (updated with every update) to answer about the desktop. Knowledge only: opens no tool.
panel.welcome_intro: Welcome. A few settings to start with; everything can be changed later in Settings.
panel.welcome_brain_hint: Alison has no model of her own: she uses the brain chosen in Omarchy (omarchy default agent).
panel.welcome_brain_change: Change brain: omarchy default agent claude (in a terminal), then reopen this panel.
panel.welcome_mode_later: Code and Autonomous are opened later, in Settings, knowingly.
panel.welcome_persona_hint: Keep Alison or give her another name. Her personality is changed in Settings › Roles.
panel.welcome_voice_hint: Everything stays on the machine: about 1.3 GB of model downloads, plus voice packages. Checksums verified. Nothing is installed without this click.
panel.welcome_access_hint: Home Assistant, mail, accounting: each is set up and tested on its own. Tests only read, they switch nothing on.
panel.welcome_access_home: Lights, heating, media; doors and covers need a click. The test reads the list of rooms, it switches nothing on.
panel.welcome_access_mail: Read-only. Credentials stay in your vault.
panel.welcome_access_erp: Dolibarr, read-only: invoices, unpaid bills, turnover.
panel.welcome_shortcut_hint: The plugin never edits your configuration. Add this line to ~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua:
panel.brain_level_complete_hint: Cards, guard and closed vault verified for this brain.
panel.brain_level_certifying_hint: Not yet safe to use: its connection does not relay every approval yet. For now: omarchy default agent claude.
panel.brain_level_recheck: to be re-verified for this version
panel.brain_level_recheck_hint: This version has not been verified yet: nothing extra is restricted, the check is still to be done.
panel.brain_level_uncertified_hint: This brain has not yet proven it respects Alison's approvals.
panel.brain_level_missing_hint: The brain chosen in Omarchy is not installed.
panel.brain_level_none_hint: Choose a brain: omarchy default agent claude.
panel.role_readonly_hint: Read from another folder (rolePaths setting): edit it there.
panel.role_form_name_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes. It is the name you say: “take the support role”.
panel.role_form_persona_hint: Who she is, what she knows, how she works. Written here → role.md. Or give an existing file below, nothing is copied.
panel.role_form_persona_keep: Leave empty to keep the persona in place; write here to replace it.
panel.role_form_ceiling_hint: The notches above will be closed in this role. A role can open nothing.
panel.role_form_access_hint: Unchecked = closed in this role. An access not set up stays not set up.
panel.role_form_forbid_hint: In any command, comma-separated (e.g. smtp, sendmail)
panel.role_hint: A role says who answers, with which trade, and what it TAKES AWAY. It can never open a right. It is picked under Alison’s name.
panel.role_where: A role is a folder dropped in ~/.config/omarchy-companion/roles (role.md for the persona, role.json for what it takes away). The folders of the rolePaths setting are read as well.
panel.preview_tip: Open the page in a window placed beside the panel (read-only, throwaway profile)
panel.hello:
Hello. What shall we do together?

Talk to me, or just type.
panel.card_always_tip: Pages from {0} will be read without a card (Settings › Security to remove)
panel.card_always_here_tip: “{0}” will not ask again until the next conversation (Settings › Security to undo)
panel.language_hint: Language of the panel, answers, voice and listening. The wake word follows it.
panel.mode_chat_hint: No tool at all: no command, no file, no web. She answers from what she knows — the fastest, and nothing can happen.
panel.mode_read_hint: She reads the machine and searches the web, she changes nothing. No approval card exists in this mode: a requested action is refused outright, not proposed.
panel.mode_ladder: From most closed to most open. The mode is picked in the panel; a role can close the upper notches, never open one.
panel.mode_code_hint: Full development session: skills, MCP, memory. Vault readable by card, never displayed.
panel.mode_auto_hint: Everything Code can do, without a card: accepted and written to the journal. Vault and private places closed again. Opens by click only, never by voice.
panel.mode_assistant_hint: Restricted system assistant: free reading, every action confirmed by button.
panel.field_endpoint: API URL (with /v1 for a compatible API)
panel.voice_missing: The local voice is not installed: Piper (speech), Vosk (wake word), Parakeet and Whisper (transcription). About 1.3 GB of model downloads, plus voice packages. Checksums verified; no model download when listening.
panel.wake_on_hint: Say “{0}”, then talk once the panel opens.
panel.wake_off_hint: Wake word off · mic closed outside dictation
panel.home_hint: Lights, heating and media without a card; covers, switches, scripts and scenes with a card. Locks and alarm always excluded.
panel.home_token_saved: Token saved, paste a new token to replace it
panel.always_hint: These action families no longer ask, until the next conversation or mode change. Every run stays in the journal.
panel.trusted_none: None. Their pages would be read without a card: the “Always for this site” button of a web-page card adds one.
panel.trusted_some: Their pages are read without a card (the exact site, not its subdomains). Every read stays in the journal.
panel.private_none: None declared. .env and vault.json files are closed by default in Assistant; to close your own vault too: omarchy bar set <id> privatePaths "~/my-vault"
panel.private_some: Closed in Assistant and Autonomous modes, open in Code mode by card, never shown: {0}
panel.denied_hint: Whatever the mode: root (sudo, pkexec), recursive deletion, disks, SSH keys, keyring, browser and mail profiles.
panel.strip_more: longer answer — click to open it
panel.stt_hint: Parakeet understands a command in 0.2 to 0.4 s (Whisper: 2 to 2.5 s), measured on a laptop CPU. Automatic fallback to the other installed engine. “Install the voice” downloads both and verifies their checksums before listening.
panel.strip_hint: The wake word used to open the whole panel, veil and keyboard included, for three words. The strip shows what she understood and her answer without taking anything: you keep typing. An action to approve still opens the panel.
panel.barge_hint: While she speaks, the microphone listens for one word: stop, quiet, hush. On its own — a sentence containing the word does not count, or she would cut herself off hearing it. Needs the wake word, it is the same microphone.
panel.mic_hint: An echo-cancelled virtual microphone can subtract her voice from captured audio so you can interrupt by speaking. Optional setup: copy examples/99-alison-echo.conf following the README, then select alison_micro here. Results depend on your hardware and volume.
panel.sortie_hint: The name of a PipeWire output (pactl list short sinks). If it disappears — robot unplugged — she speaks through the system output, never mute.
panel.decide_hint: While a card waits: “approve”, “allow it”, “do it” to allow; “no”, “refuse”, “cancel”, “leave it” to refuse. Asymmetric on purpose — allowing needs a deliberate word, plain “yes” does not count: it is the most spoken word in a room, and a card waits two minutes.
panel.desk_hint: These phrases never reach the brain: they run in under a second, on Omarchy’s own commands.
panel.desk_list:
“Remind me in 20 minutes to take the cake out” · “remind me at 3:30 pm to call Paul” · “my reminders” · “clear my reminders”
“Open the clipboard” · “the emojis” · “share the clipboard” · “take a screenshot” · “go to desktop 3”
“Note in Obsidian: …” · “look at my screen”
panel.desk_vault: Path to the Obsidian vault (empty = no notes)
panel.desk_vault_hint: “Note in Obsidian: …” appends a timestamped line to the daily note (YYYY-MM-DD.md), leaving the rest of the file alone.
panel.desk_screen: “Look at my screen” photographs the whole screen, asks you every time, then deletes the photo as soon as it has answered.
panel.mail_hint: She reads your mailbox to summarise it. Credentials are not typed here: point to where they live — a JSON vault and the “section.key” holding address, password, host and port. The password never leaves the helper.
panel.mail_readonly: No sending, no deleting, no filing: those verbs do not exist. Attachments are reported, never opened.
panel.memory_hint: Said by you (“remember that…”, “forget…”) or written here. Read at the start of each session, never spoken aloud unless you ask. Never a password: anything that looks like one is refused.
panel.memory_notes: Daily notes: {0} day(s) written on this laptop, never sent. She will draw from them what deserves keeping.
panel.recall_hint: Before answering, she re-reads the previous days’ notes and attaches the passages that match your question. Local, no extra call.
panel.dream_hint: Once a day, machine idle and panel closed: she re-reads the past days’ notes, keeps what recurs, fixes what became wrong. She never erases, and you can undo it all.
panel.wake_service_died: The wake-word service stopped three times: check the voice in Settings.
panel.widget_listening: {0} is listening for the wake word
panel.delegation_switch: Roles may ask each other questions
panel.delegation_hint: A read-only round trip, never beyond the rights of the one asking; the answer is quoted under the name of who answered. Each role picks whom it may ask in its card.
panel.role_delegate_hint: Unchecked = this role will never ask that one. Uncheck all = it asks nobody.
panel.voice_incomplete_hint: Parakeet or the verified Whisper folder is missing. Complete downloads only missing or altered files: about 465 MB for Parakeet and 486 MB for Whisper, plus missing packages.
panel.card_full_content: Full content is available: scroll this area before approving.
panel.backup_free_text_preview: Free-form text in this file — review before restoring

engine.reply.forget_none: I have nothing like that in memory.

engine.reply.mode_read: Read mode: I look, I touch nothing.
